# reference-video-studio-saas - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**What you'll get:** 제공된 9개 Stitch 화면을 그대로 살린 실제 Reference Video Studio SaaS입니다. 151개 UI 조작이 모두 인증·업로드·격리·분석·승인·렌더·다운로드·관리 기능에 연결되고, 4초 영상 구간을 실제로 계측해 편집 가능한 장면과 결정적 결과 영상을 만듭니다.

**Why this approach:** 화면 목업에 기능을 흉내 내지 않고, 문서가 정한 증거 우선 파이프라인과 승인 권위를 끝까지 구현합니다. 동시에 단일 서버·단일 작업자·로컬 데이터베이스로 시작해 검증되지 않은 분산 구조는 만들지 않습니다.

**What it will NOT do:** 생성형 영상 모델, 캡처 이미지로 납작하게 만든 UI, 승인 우회, 교차 고객 데이터 접근, 실행 중 외부 자산 다운로드, 실제 결제, 또는 임의의 5분 영상에 대한 품질 보장은 포함하지 않습니다. 검증된 제품 경계는 선택한 정확한 4초 구간입니다.

**Effort:** XL
**Risk:** High - GPU 없이 전체 비전 분석과 엄격한 브라우저 런타임·승인·테넌트 경계를 동시에 구현하고 검증해야 합니다.
**Decisions to sanity-check:** 정확한 4초 파일럿 경계, Chromium 패치 버전 고정, CPU 전용 모델 스택, 단일 호스트 SQLite/작업자, 지정 심사자만 가능한 T1-T6 승인입니다.

Your next move: 이 플랜을 별도 워커 세션에서 실행하거나, 실행 전에 고정밀 이중 리뷰를 선택합니다. Full execution detail follows below.

## Scope
### Must have
- Greenfield pnpm workspace with `apps/web` (Next.js), `apps/api` (Fastify), `apps/worker` (Node CDP/FFmpeg), `packages/contracts` (shared Zod schemas), `compiler` (uv-managed Python), and Docker Compose for the exact production runtime.
- Every Stitch artifact is the visual authority: all 9 HTML/screenshots and `stitch-extracted/stitch_design_system_ui_implementation/cosmic_engineering/DESIGN.md` are ported, and all 151 inventoried controls have a machine-readable behavior mapping and an agent-executed Playwright assertion.
- Two deliberate auth surfaces: same-origin browser BFF with cookie session+CSRF; direct `/v1` bearer+mandatory `X-Tenant-Id` except release-scoped `POST /v1/release-reviews`, which forbids `X-Tenant-Id` and uses only server-derived release assignment; direct `/admin` bearer with server-derived platform/assignment scope and tenant only as a constrained filter. All derive principals server-side and apply the same capability/fencing rules.
- Canonical full persisted lifecycle from `handoff-extracted/workflow.md`; creator API projects the six public states while authorized admin/detail views expose internal states and safe reasons.
- Input boundary: one MP4 <=2 GiB, 1-300s, CFR 24/25/30/50/60, decoded long/short side <=3840/2160 with rotation honored; selected analysis interval exactly 4.0s and <=240 frames; sandboxed quarantine/probe/normalization, immutable original CAS, normalized CFR working copy.
- CPU-bounded full compiler over every admitted frame: OCR/UI bounds, matting/residual canvas, tracking/lifecycle, camera/depth, rhythm, owner-bound effects, and 48kHz audio anchors; confidence and every fail-closed state preserved.
- Designated reviewer assignments and predecessor-enforced T1-T6 gates; no system/admin/tenant-role approval shortcut; append-only receipts and stale-approval invalidation.
- AuthoringIR -> SceneIR -> BrowserPassSpec compiler; semantic DOM/SVG UI, owner-bound WebGL2 passes, pure `renderFrame(frame)`, exact Chromium `151.0.7922.138`, SwiftShader, blocked render-time network, FFmpeg mux/QC.
- One-host SQLite WAL topology with transactional leases, one active compiler/render worker, serialized receipt writer, retry/cancel/crash recovery, quotas, retention, deletion epochs, expiring authorized downloads/exports.
- Linux-native tests-after QA harness: every todo has a runnable happy case, failure case, and evidence artifact; synthetic and adversarial videos reproduce all 16 frozen fixture IDs.
- Explicit pilot label and resource bounds: this plan proves a 4-second selected-interval capability on the 4-core CPU host; longer/production-quality claims require a later approved benchmark.

- Normative source identity is `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-normative-inputs.json` (40 original files, 2 derived indexes, aggregate SHA-256 `ebd2c7b53d8e3adf4b582bb0604b67e1b02dbfa3dd2dbefadbe3c037a4e10f11`). Todo 1 verifies it before any project file is created; any drift stops with `NORMATIVE_INPUT_DRIFT`.

Todo 1 is an authority-bootstrap stop-gate: before product source it materializes complete pnpm/uv/container/Debian/GPL-enabled FFmpeg+x264 transitive closures, hydrates every hash-addressed artifact, proves frozen offline installation, and emits a child authority root. An unavailable or drifting pin stops `SUPPLY_PIN_UNAVAILABLE`; no task chooses a version.

Container format: one Markdown file whose single fenced `json` block is the root manifest (`schemaVersion rvs-authority-root-v1`); verifiers hash the entire `.md` file bytes and parse that block. Its own SHA-256 is supplied out-of-workspace as `RVS_AUTHORITY_ROOT_SHA256`; it never contains itself. Declared child roots may only add Todo 1 dependency closures, the Todo 1 fixture-output lock, the Todo 3 verifier root, and the Todo 45 release manifest while preserving `parentRootSha256`; Todo 4 reproduces the fixture lock verification-only. F2-F4 emit attempt-local final receipts first, then F1 serially consumes the final hash-linked root chain and canonical evidence index as the aggregator.

Final gates run this pack against built processes from outside the production packages.

### Canonical lifecycle and projection
- Upload sessions are separate from jobs: `CREATED -> UPLOADING -> VALIDATING -> ACCEPTED|QUARANTINED|INPUT_INVALID`, with `ABORTED|EXPIRED` terminal alternatives. No job exists before `ACCEPTED`; `POST /v1/jobs` resolves the normalized artifact server-side and creates `PREPARING`.
| Persisted job-attempt state | Legal next states | Creator projection | Terminal/retry policy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PREPARING` | `READY`, `CANCEL_REQUESTED`, `FAILED` | `PREPARING` | transient max 3 automatic run records inside PREPARING; no approval or QUEUED jump before READY |
| `READY` | `QUEUED`, `STALE_APPROVAL`, `FAILED` | `PREPARING` | waits for current gate approval |
| `STALE_APPROVAL` | `READY`, `FAILED` | `PREPARING` + `blockedReason` | explicit reapproval only |
| `QUEUED` | `RENDERING`, `CANCEL_REQUESTED`, `FAILED` | `QUEUED` | ordered claim only |
| `RENDERING` | `ASSEMBLING`, `CANCEL_REQUESTED`, `RETRYABLE_ERROR`, `FAILED` | `RENDERING` | transient max 3 automatic attempts |
| `ASSEMBLING` | `AWAITING_T5`, `RETRYABLE_ERROR`, `FAILED` | `RENDERING` | bounded and not cancellable; writes private staged artifacts only |
| `AWAITING_T5` | `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, `STALE_APPROVAL` | `RENDERING` + `awaitingFinalReview=true` | T5 approve publishes; T5 reject is `FAILED/T5_REJECTED` and a new render attempt |
| `CANCEL_REQUESTED` | `CANCELLED`, `FAILED` | prior visible phase + `cancelRequested=true` | waits for worker acknowledgement |
| `RETRYABLE_ERROR` | `PREPARING`, `QUEUED`, `FAILED` | prior visible phase + safe error | stage-specific same-attempt recovery only: PREPARING returns to PREPARING; render/assembly returns to QUEUED; new jobAttemptId only after manual retry from terminal FAILED |
| `COMPLETED` | none | `COMPLETED` | terminal |
| `CANCELLED` | none | `CANCELLED` | terminal |
| `FAILED` | none | `FAILED` | terminal; manual retry creates attempt |
- Exact state, T5, gate decision, assignment, invalidation and T6 release-subject semantics are frozen in `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-execution-contract-v2.json`.
- Gate progress and render progress are separate fields: `approvedGateCount/requiredGateCount` never derives from frames; `framesRendered/framesTotal` never implies approval or completion.
- Queue order is `(eligible_at ASC, created_at ASC, job_id ASC)` using database UTC time. Claim uses one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction with `lease_owner`, `lease_token`, `lease_expires_at`; receipt uniqueness is `(tenant_id, job_attempt_id, gate, predecessor_id, decision_version)` and per-attempt `sequence_no` is allocated by the single receipt writer.

| Gate | Evidence/actor | Predecessor | Invalidators | Permitted command -> resulting state | Blocks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 | input/runtime/font/model/network preflight; assigned T1 reviewer | none | source interval, runtime or asset manifest change | `POST /v1/reviews {gate:T1}` -> `PREPARING` compiler-admitted | compiler admission |
| T2 | complete OBSERVED/MAPPED bundle + resolved choice; assigned T2 reviewer | T1 approved | source/compiler/evidence change | `POST /v1/reviews {gate:T2}` -> version-bound scene compilation eligible | AuthoringIR compile |
| T3 | one editable 9:16 styleframe + owner/geometry comparison; assigned T3 reviewer | T2 approved | IR/styleframe/asset change | `POST /v1/reviews {gate:T3}` -> animatic generation eligible | animatic preview |
| T4 | normal-speed animatic + motion/VFX/mute/sound checks; assigned T4 reviewer | T3 approved | SceneIR/pass/timing/audio change | `POST /v1/reviews {gate:T4}` -> `READY`; render command may queue | final render |
| T5 | exact 4-second final shot + fixed-frame/media QC + would-use decision; assigned T5 reviewer | T4 approved | any render/runtime/output change | `POST /v1/reviews {gate:T5}` -> delivery reference published and `COMPLETED` | tenant delivery publication |
| T6 | isolated restore + fixed-frame comparison + recovery report; assigned release reviewer | immutable release baseline manifest digest referencing at least one T5-approved pilot chain | package/runtime/recovery change | `POST /v1/release-reviews {gate:T6,scope:release}` with no `X-Tenant-Id` and a `tenantId=null` release assignment -> release/handoff eligible | system release/handoff only, not an already T5-approved tenant download |
- System/compiler/worker may append evidence-ready records but never approval. `super-admin`, `ops-admin`, `viewer`, tenant `OWNER`, `ADMIN`, and `MEMBER` cannot approve T2-T6. `POST /v1/reviews` is implemented with Todo 14, not Todo 11.

### Exact media and capacity contract
- Source: one parseable MP4 <=2 GiB, duration 1-300s, CFR 24/25/30/50/60, display orientation from rotation metadata, maximum decoded long side 3840 and short side 2160. Landscape is accepted and fitted into 9:16 output; it is not cropped silently.
- Selection: start is an exact source frame index; interval is half-open `[startFrame, startFrame + 4*sourceFps)`, therefore exactly 96/100/120/200/240 measured source frames. Output is always 120 frames at 30fps, 1080x1920, square pixels, yuv420p, BT.709 color metadata.
- Audio: input audio is normalized to 48kHz stereo. Silent input is accepted by synthesizing exact 4-second silence and recording `audio.synthetic=true`; absent measured cues remain absent rather than invented.
- Encoding: H.264 High Profile level 4.1, CRF 18, preset medium, closed GOP 60, `+faststart`; AAC-LC 192kbps/48kHz/stereo. Commands are fixed in the verification contract.
- ML policy: first attempt uses 540x960 display-oriented frames for RVM/depth/camera/effects while OCR receives native-resolution crops; all source frames remain measured. One active compiler/render job, torch threads=4, OpenCV threads=1, batch size=1, <=12GiB RSS, <=30min compile, <=15min render+assembly. Todo 17 consumes the Todo 4 fixture corpus and benchmarks 96/100/120/200/240-frame probes, including the 240-frame 4K dense-OCR fixture, before compiler implementation; if full analysis exceeds a bound, the preapproved fallback is the same all-frame pipeline at 360x640 for non-OCR stages with unchanged native OCR crops/threshold recalibration. If fallback fails, stop `COMPILER_CAPACITY_UNPROVEN`; do not continue to UI/product work.
- Disk admission: reserve `max(10GiB, 4*sourceBytes + 2GiB)` and maintain >=20GiB global free space; reject with `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` before upload finalization if unavailable.

### Supported pilot owner and measurement contract
- Owner taxonomy is fixed to `text-word`, `subtitle`, `ui-surface`, `foreground-subject`, and `global-residual`. Text/subtitle masks come from EasyOCR regions; UI surfaces come from deterministic contour/rectangle grouping around measured text/edges; RVM supplies one foreground-subject alpha; every remaining pixel belongs to global residual. Multiple ambiguous non-text instances produce one `NEEDS CHOICE` polygon assignment and cannot auto-approve—no unspecified generic instance detector is assumed.
- Todo dependency is strict: OCR/UI detection (19) -> matting/owner tracking (20) -> camera/depth/rhythm/effects/audio (21). No stage consumes undefined detector masks.
- Camera uses RANSAC homography on background/residual features: translation px/frame, rotation deg/frame, multiplicative scale/frame; `px/ms = px/frame * fps / 1000`; inlier ratio <0.60 emits `CAMERA_OBJECT_TRAJECTORY_COLLISION`. Depth is median MiDaS normalized depth per owner; separation margin <0.05 emits `UNCLASSIFIED_DEPTH_OVERLAP`/NEEDS CHOICE.
- Bloom is the radial high-luminance halo profile outside alpha; defocus radius is the best-matching Gaussian sigma from a fixed 0-32px synthetic calibration bank; rim is boundary-normal gradient magnitude/profile; lower light is a 16x9 median luminance residual field; rhythm is activity/audio-onset peaks; easing is the least-error fixed candidate fit (`linear`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`) with residual reported. Every metric retains units, formula version and confidence.

### Authentication and API action contract
- `/v1`: direct clients use bearer + mandatory `X-Tenant-Id`; membership intersection yields exactly one tenant. The sole direct `/v1` exception is `POST /v1/release-reviews`, which forbids `X-Tenant-Id`, requires a release-scope T6 assignment with `tenantId=null`, and cannot be widened by tenant membership. Browser uses same-origin Next.js BFF endpoints with HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax session + origin-bound CSRF. The BFF service credential is audience-limited to `session:introspect`; each call forwards only an opaque session ID plus a CSRF assertion, never a tenant claim, capability, role or user ID. The API re-resolves user, selected tenant, capabilities, membership and authz/deletion/restore epochs on every request. Suspension/removal increments epochs, revokes sessions/tokens/downloads, pauses claims and stops active work at the next boundary exactly as frozen in `reference-video-studio-saas-execution-contract-v2.json`.
- `/admin`: super-admin platform reads omit `X-Tenant-Id`; target tenant is only a query filter. Assigned ops/viewer reads and every mutation derive allowed tenant IDs from server assignments; tenant-specific mutations require the target header to match an assignment. Caller input never widens scope.
- Required creator/API paths beyond the original five are fixed: upload chunk/finalize/abort; job list/cancel/retry; evidence/IR/preview/choice/topology version APIs; current-gate review; render launch; attempt/report/artifact reads. Admin paths additionally cover dashboard/jobs, member assignment, suspend, quota/plan metadata, queue drain/resume/retry, quarantine evidence/reject/release, receipt/audit exports. `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-control-contract.jsonl` fixes one method/path/auth/idempotency/version/state/audit/result/failure row per source control; Todo 30 may only add selectors, never redefine behavior.
- `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-api-action-contract.json` is the request/response schema and coverage registry. Every non-local control resolves by canonical method+path to one operation, except the explicitly declared upload control `upload_validation:8`, which resolves to its fixed create→chunk→finalize sequence. Every operation is classified exactly once as direct-control, composite-control, screen-load/state, additional required control, or ops-only; schema-less, unmatched, multiply classified, or unclassified operations fail Todo 3. Local navigation/input/drawer/playback rows are bounded by their row contract and make no network request beyond referenced reads.

### Audit event registry
- `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-audit-registry-v2.json` is the single closed enum and outcome mapping for all handoff events, workflow events, login outcomes, queue drain/resume, reviewer assignment and export download. Todo 3 rejects every alias, compound ambiguity, operation without a producer, and control/API mismatch.

### Editable IR, audit and recovery contract
- Persist immutable `authoring_ir_versions`, `scene_ir_versions`, and `browser_pass_spec_versions` with content digest, parent version, editor, reason and timestamp. The exact JSON Patch subset, ranges and fail-atomic AuthoringIR→SceneIR→BrowserPassSpec→preview saga are frozen in `reference-video-studio-saas-execution-contract-v2.json`; failed edits retain the prior current chain.
- Audit records remain indefinitely append-only in primary storage for the pilot. `90d` is the minimum hot-query/export window, not deletion; a later archive transition is out of scope. Media/export TTLs do not delete audit/receipt history.
- CAS publication uses write→file fsync→digest→same-filesystem rename→parent fsync→fenced DB commit; kill points and orphan recovery are mandatory. Backup/restore order is frozen in `reference-video-studio-saas-execution-contract-v2.json` and tested at every boundary.

### Must NOT have (guardrails, anti-slop, scope boundaries)
- No dead control, `href="#"`, ornamental pseudo-button, visual-only disabled state, or invented mutation. Unsupported Stitch actions must route to a bounded supported behavior or a state-driven disabled control with a visible reason.
- No diffusion/video-generation authority, screenshot-flattened UI, generic substitute scene, camera-only similarity claim, contact-sheet compiler, fixed fallback trajectory, or VLM-written measurement.
- No unbound VFX/audio, merged unmeasured bloom+defocus, residual treatment baked into product UI, or missing-owner render pass.
- No silent Chrome/font/model/shader/GPU fallback, wall-clock animation, draw-time randomness, runtime asset download, or external network during render.
- No cross-tenant lookup/download/export, mutable receipt/audit history, stale approval reuse, admin T2-T6 approval, caller-controlled tenant scope, or hash-as-approval gate.
- No real payments/card data, email/SMS/password-reset backend, arbitrary worker code, shader editor, multi-region storage, horizontal workers, sharded queues, or production claim for arbitrary 5-minute clips.
- No host Node 25/Python 3.14 as production authority; no substitution of installed Chrome `.169` for required `.138`; no NFS/network-mounted SQLite.

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: tests-after. TypeScript uses Vitest + Fastify inject tests; Python uses pytest; browser flows use Playwright; accessibility uses axe-core; media/runtime checks use ffprobe, Chrome CDP, and deterministic image comparisons. No separate test-only todo: implementation and its tests ship together.
- Universal task runner after Todo 3: `pnpm qa -- --task <N> --scenario happy|failure --evidence <attemptDir>/task-<N>-reference-video-studio-saas.json`. It must execute the mapped validator, record command/stdout/stderr/assertions/artifacts, and return non-zero with the expected stable token for failure fixtures.
- Baseline quality gate in the pinned QA container: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && uv run --frozen --offline --project compiler pytest && pnpm build`.
- Media gate: ffprobe asserts duration/frame count/fps/dimensions/H.264/AAC-48kHz-stereo; repeated frame renders must be byte-identical on the pinned runtime; Linux similarity baselines are fixture-local evidence and never promote or rewrite historical Windows authority.
- UI gate: Playwright consumes the locked `.omo/drafts/reference-video-studio-saas-control-contract.jsonl` through selector-only `tests/control-manifest.json`, executes all 151 entries at desktop and narrow viewports, and proves accessible name, role/state policy, endpoint/audit/result, keyboard/focus behavior, and forbidden/disabled paths.
- Security gate: negative matrix covers missing/invalid credentials, CSRF, bearer/session mismatch, cross-tenant IDs, stale deletion epoch, receipt mutation, forbidden gate actors, expired/failed/partial downloads, runtime network, model/font absence, lease theft, and duplicate idempotency keys.
- Evidence: task-local receipts remain under `<attemptDir>`, but every implementation receipt is hash-linked into canonical `.omo/evidence/index.jsonl` by the exclusive evidence writer using the exact row schema in `reference-video-studio-saas-execution-contract-v2.json`; F2-F4 write separate attempt-local final receipts and F1 serially imports/indexes them before the no-new-evidence closure check.

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
> Target 5-8 todos per wave. Fewer than 3 (except the final) means you under-split.
- Wave 1 — foundation and architecture stop-gate: Todos 1-6 and 17. Runtime authority, immutable black-box verification pack, fixtures, DB/contracts, locked models, and CPU/RSS feasibility. Todo 17 starts only after Todo 4 has reproduced the fixture lock, and Todo 17 must pass before Wave 2 begins.
- Wave 2 — trust boundary: Todos 7-12. Auth, tenant fencing, sandboxed upload/quarantine/CAS, normalization, creator APIs, admin reads.
- Wave 3 — authority + compiler: Todos 13-16 and 18-23. Admin mutations/audit, gates/receipts, queue/retention, measurement stages, compiler orchestration.
- Wave 4 — renderer: Todos 24-29. IR compilation, DOM/SVG, WebGL2, pinned CDP, FFmpeg publication, end-to-end worker state flow.
- Wave 5 — creator UI: Todos 30-35. Shared shell/control map, landing/static routes, sign-in, upload, review, queue/delivery.
- Wave 6 — admin UI: Todos 36-40. Shared admin primitives, tenants, receipts, quarantine, audit.
- Wave 7 — integration/handoff: Todos 41-45. Complete control coverage, accessibility/fidelity, adversarial security/concurrency, pilot benchmark, deployment/recovery/docs.
- A wave may parallelize only where the dependency matrix permits. Database migration, receipt append, queue claim, and plan/control-manifest numbering are single-writer operations.

## Commit strategy
- Use one atomic commit per todo with the exact commit line specified above; do not combine waves or commit generated runtime data, uploads, model weights, SQLite DBs, videos, evidence, secrets, or build caches.
- Commit manifests/lockfiles/licenses for runtime/model/font artifacts, but hydrate large binaries through verified build scripts into ignored local paths.
- Before each commit run that todo's happy+failure QA; before wave merge run the baseline quality gate. Never commit a red gate or amend unrelated user changes.
- Suggested branch/worktree: task-owned worktree with `--make-pr`; because this workspace is not currently a git repository, Todo 1 initializes only when the worker confirms the user wants branch/PR delivery—otherwise commit lines remain logical checkpoints without remote actions.

## Success criteria
- The app cold-starts from documented Docker commands on this Linux host and exact runtime preflight proves Chrome `151.0.7922.138`, SwiftShader/WebGL2, Node 24, locked CPU Python models/fonts, FFmpeg, local-only assets, and blocked render-time network.
- All 9 Stitch designs are present and visually/accessibly faithful; the executable manifest reports exactly `151/151` controls with real navigation, state, API/audit side effects, or contract-justified disabled reason—zero `href="#"`, dead controls, or visual-only disabled states.
- Creator/admin APIs conform to generated contracts; browser cookie+CSRF and bearer APIs derive the same principal; all tenant/resource/download/export checks fail closed without leakage.
- A valid MP4 passes quarantine/validation, yields separate immutable source and normalized working artifacts, and exactly a 4-second <=240-frame interval runs through every compiler measurement with source-bound confidence/fail-closed evidence.
- Only assigned designated reviewers can advance predecessor-bound T1-T6; stale changes invalidate approval; receipts/audits are append-only; render success never equals approval.
- AuthoringIR/SceneIR/BrowserPassSpec remains editable and owner-complete; pinned DOM/SVG+WebGL2 capture is deterministic; FFmpeg publishes only exact-QC media and report.
- One-host SQLite queue survives concurrent claims, cancellation, retry, crash, restart, deletion epoch and cleanup without duplicate work/reordered receipts; retention/session/export TTLs match the contracts.
- The five 4-second Linux FPS profiles (24, 25, 30, 50, and 60fps dense-OCR-4K) satisfy resource/media/determinism/fixture-local similarity thresholds and all adversarial/ablation cases block publication; docs make no claim beyond that proven boundary.
- Final handoff and isolated T6 recovery pass with no secrets/path escapes and canonical `recovery-report.json`; F1-F4 all APPROVE.
